attributes.title: CASSW Annual Conference 2027: The Architecture of Care
attributes.venue: Los Angeles County Office of Education (LACOE)
attributes.cme_provider: National Association of Social Workers (CEU provider)
attributes.organizer: California Association of School Social Workers
attributes.summary:
The California Association of School Social Workers holds its 2027 conference, "The Architecture of Care: Anchoring Our Schools in Uncertain Times", on February 11 and 12, 2027, at the Los Angeles County Office of Education in Downey. Sessions cover attendance, restorative practices, family engagement, multidisciplinary teams, advocacy and supervision.

NASW is listed as the CEU provider. The number of hours was not published. Non-members pay a separate CEU fee of $15 for one day or $25 for both days; these are the CEU charges, not the registration price.

Registration had not opened when we checked, and conference rates were not posted yet; members receive discounted registration.
